answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies relies on economic staking. Each agent must lock a substantial token collateral as its identity anchor, effectively a secure jetty from which it operates. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities faces the cumulative cost of acquiring and staking these tokens. Without this stake, any purported new identity is fleeting, a mere zephyr quickly disregarded, leaving behind only the relic of a failed attempt.
